en.headline: Exchange Fund records HK$134.7 billion investment income in first half
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said total assets rose to HK$4,463.6 billion while the fund posted gains on bonds and other equities despite a loss on local stocks.
body: The Exchange Fund recorded an investment income of HK$134.7 billion in the first half of 2026, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced on Tuesday.

According to the unaudited figures, gains on bonds contributed HK$49.1 billion and gains on other equities HK$53.7 billion. Losses on Hong Kong equities amounted to HK$11.8 billion. A positive currency translation effect on non-Hong Kong dollar assets added HK$34.3 billion, while other investments generated HK$9.4 billion.
Total assets of the Exchange Fund stood at HK$4,463.6 billion at the end of June, an increase of HK$302.4 billion from the end of 2025. The accumulated surplus reached HK$862.7 billion.

HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue said global markets recovered in the second quarter after volatility earlier in the year linked to geopolitical tensions. He noted that strong performance in artificial-intelligence-related sectors supported equity markets, while US dollar bond yields remained relatively high. Looking ahead, the authority said it would continue to prioritise capital preservation and maintain liquidity amid possible market uncertainties in the second half.

zh.headline: 外匯基金上半年錄得1347億元投資收入
zh.dek: 金管局公布，外匯基金總資產增至4.46萬億元，債券及其他股票錄得收益，但香港股票投資出現虧損。
body: 香港金融管理局星期二公布，外匯基金在2026年上半年錄得1347億元投資收入。
金管局表示，債券投資收益為491億元，其他股票收益537億元，香港股票則錄得118億元虧損。非港元資產的正匯兌換算效應帶來343億元，其他投資收益為94億元。
截至6月底，外匯基金總資產達4.4636萬億元，較2025年底增加3024億元；累計盈餘為8627億元。
金管局總裁余偉文表示，全球金融市場在第二季顯著復甦，人工智能相關板塊表現強勁帶動美股及亞太區股市。展望下半年，金管局將繼續以保本為先，維持高流動性，並分散投資以爭取長期回報，確保外匯基金有效維持香港貨幣及金融穩定。
